messages.subject: Project Cedar — Verrell's position on royalty and cap
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Marcus,

Verrell have come back at 5% on the running royalty (down from 6%), a 45-day cure period, a 60% third-party deduction and a £3m liability cap. My recommendation: concede the 45-day cure, meet in the middle at 5.5% on the rate, accept the 60% deduction (it's only relevant if a third-party licence is actually needed), and counter the cap at £4m. That keeps the economics close to plan.

Grateful for your steer so we can send our counter-draft.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
